verdict.line: You lose if you trade into a raised Counter Strike (E); you win almost every extended fight because Garen out-sustains and out-scales Jax's short burst window.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by one mechanic: Jax's entire trade pattern revolves around baiting a spell into Counter Strike (E) to dodge it and stun you, and Garen's kit is uniquely bad at falling for that because Judgment (E) and autos aren't blockable the way Q's silence is. At 55.9% over 1,108 games with a stated solo-kill edge, Garen wins the war of attrition as long as he respects the E window instead of forcing Q into it.

theirWindow.when: Jax raises his shield stance (E active)
theirWindow.what: He is baiting Decisive Strike (Q) or an auto to dodge and stun you for 1s+bonus damage. Hold Q, keep autoing or spin with Judgment (E), and do not commit your combo into a raised block.

yourWindow.when: Jax's E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Walk up, land Judgment (E) for the spin damage and armor shred, silence with Decisive Strike (Q) to lock out his Leap Strike (Q) reset/escape, and stack autos while your passive Perseverance ticks between hits.

start.why: 56.1% win rate over 661 games and the higher pick (46.9%). The flat damage reduction on autos and passive regen directly counter Jax's poke-and-Counter-Strike trade pattern, keeping you healthy enough to force the all-in windows.

boots.why: 55.8% win rate over 1,006 games and dominant 73.9% pick. Attack speed accelerates your Judgment (E) spin ticks and auto-reset trades, which is how you punish Jax while his E is down.

core.why: The slow-on-hit lets you stick through Jax's Leap Strike (Q) reset and keeps him in Judgment (E) range for the full spin duration.
Attack speed and crit push your DPS well past Jax's short E-dodge window; this path hits 58.9% over 326 games.
Grievous Wounds shuts down any lifesteal or healing Jax picks up as he scales, part of the 58.9%-winrate core.

you are ahead and want to convert your lead into a faster teamfight burst
you need extra gap-close speed to stay on top of Jax's Leap Strike (Q) mobility

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking damage and healing reward exactly the extended-trade playstyle this matchup wants: stay in range through Jax's cooldowns and the adaptive force/healing scales your sustain right alongside your passive, Perseverance.

summoners.why: 97.2% pick rate at 56.1% win rate. Ignite converts your stated solo-kill advantage into real kills by cutting off any last-second heal or Flash-out attempt once Jax's E is down and you're mid all-in.

playing.title: Never Q into a raised E
playing.detail: If Jax's shoulders go up (Counter Strike active), do not throw Decisive Strike (Q) or commit your full combo. Wait him out or keep spacing with autos and Judgment (E) instead.

playing.title: Open trades with Judgment (E)
playing.detail: The patch's skill order starts E at level 1 (EQWEEREQEQRQQWW), so lead every early trade with the spin for the armor shred and AD-scaling tick before layering Q.

playing.title: Punish the moment E goes down
playing.detail: The instant Jax's Counter Strike is on cooldown, walk up and commit your full combo — Q silence to deny his Leap Strike (Q) reset, then E and autos while Perseverance heals you back.

playing.title: Save Q's silence for his escape
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence stops Jax from using Leap Strike (Q) to disengage, so hold it for the moment he tries to dash away rather than opening with it.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown from level 6
playing.detail: Once Demacian Justice (R) is up, any trade where Jax drops below roughly 40% HP is a kill — the true-damage execute closes gaps his Grandmaster's Might stacking can't cover.

playing.title: Don't fight through his empowered auto
playing.detail: Jax's stacking passive (Grandmaster's Might) hits hard every third strike; if you see it about to proc, disengage for a beat rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Itemize Mortal Reminder on schedule
playing.detail: Since this core path is already 32.7% pick at 58.9% win rate, don't delay it — Grievous Wounds keeps Jax from stabilizing once he starts building lifesteal late.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning connecting them (the E-bait pattern, trade timing, and skill-order justification) is my own read of the interaction.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Jax block [Q] by activating Counter Strike (E). Attack him whenever your skills come off cooldown and activate [P] to increase your sustain to gain the upper hand.
